meta.notes: Colour and typography roles are grounded in the site's own compiled CSS custom-property namespace (--diablo-di-*), which is stronger evidence than pixel sampling. statusCaution has no native brand equivalent (the brand only ships a warning-red and a status-green) and was derived as a warm amber sitting between the primary gold and secondary brick — flagged here per rule 15. No isolated transparent logo/wordmark file was harvested; the 'DIABLO IMMORTAL' lockup exists only baked into hero key art. Voice section is grounded in live copy read from the rendered homepage and its 404 page; deeper pages (Promotions/News/Classes detail) resolve client-side routes that did not return distinct content in this session, so commerce-specific copy (SKU/cart strings) is [inferred] from the brand voice rather than [observed].

essence.positioning: A free-to-play, fast-paced action RPG set between Diablo II and Diablo III — fight across a hell-scorched world as one of ten classes, solo or in a Warband, with new challenges every two weeks.

voice.source: live copy read from https://diabloimmortal.blizzard.com/en-us via browser (hero, latest-updates rail, class blurbs, 404 page)
voice.summary: Grand and commanding, second-person and imperative; addresses the player as someone who already wields power, not someone being onboarded.

pillars.name: Imperative & commanding
pillars.evidence: Hell Obeys Me / Become the Warlock

pillars.name: Ominous, mythic scale
pillars.evidence: Face the fury of the Lord of Terror himself in a massive campaign with over 30 hours of story.

pillars.name: Class copy as character, not stat sheet
pillars.evidence: Demon summoners who wield hazardous infernal magic and sacrifice their minions for even greater power and control.

pillars.name: Flavour even in dead ends
pillars.evidence: What you saw was not meant for mortal eyes...

voice.person: second person imperative for CTAs ("Become the Warlock", "Play Now"); third person for lore/class copy; never calls the player a pet name like "Nephalem" on this surface — stays in the grammar of command.
voice.cadence: Short imperative headlines (2–4 words) over long, subordinate-clause lore sentences. Sparse ALL-CAPS — reserved for eyebrow labels ("NEW CLASS", "ARPG · FREE TO PLAY") and buttons, never for body copy or the unicase display font (which already reads as capital-height).
voice.commerceVoice: [inferred] Promotions copy on this surface stays in the same commanding register rather than dropping into bargain-bin urgency — scarcity is framed as opportunity ("Exclusive discounts await") not countdown panic.

copyExamples.hero: The Gates Do Not Wait — Answer the Call
copyExamples.emptyState: The vault stands empty — for now.
copyExamples.errorState: Something in the dark interrupted this. Try again.

artStyle.subStyle: dark-fantasy military-grit character rendering with painterly hellscape backdrops — 3D character renders (armour, skin, VFX) composited over 2D matte/painted environment art
renderingCues: high-contrast rim lighting from fire/magic sources
physically-modelled armour and skin with painted-texture backdrops behind it
particle VFX (embers, smoke, arcane glow) layered over the composite
carved-stone and worn-leather surface detailing on UI chrome to match the in-fiction material world

primary.usage: ember-gold accent — headline gradients, class-card highlights, primary brand accent (highest-frequency hex in the compiled CSS)

secondary.usage: blood-brick — primary CTA button fill (observed on the live "Play Now" control), second most-frequent hex

tertiary.usage: cold arcane blue — "notation-blue" token family, sparing use for arcane/cold contrast against the dominant warm palette

neutral.usage: near-black warm charcoal — page background foundation ("desert-800" token)

statusPositive.usage: brand's own "status-green-400" — success / positive delta, lightened for legibility on the dark neutral

statusCaution.usage: DERIVED — the brand ships no native amber; this sits between primary gold (#D7AB6D) and secondary brick (#7B2917) at matching saturation/mood for warning/caution use

statusNegative.usage: brand's own "warning-red-400" token — error / negative delta, lightened variant for dark-background contrast

contrastRules: White body text on the neutral #1A1715 background ≈ 17.9:1 — far exceeds AA.
Primary #D7AB6D on neutral #1A1715 ≈ 8.5:1 — passes AA for body and large text; safe for headline gradients and labels.
White text on the secondary #7B2917 CTA fill ≈ 9.7:1 — passes AA comfortably even at button-label sizes.
Never place primary gold text directly on the tertiary blue or on light art without a scrim — the pairing was not observed anywhere on the live site and is likely below AA.
Status colours always pair with a shape/label cue (badge shape, +/− sign, icon) — none were observed used as the sole signal of state.

scale.pairingRationale: A unicase, rune-marked display face (Exocet Immortal) for hero/section titles reads as ancient and inscribed; a humanist sans body (Alegreya Sans) keeps long-form lore and UI copy legible; Archivo (grotesque sans, semibold) is reserved for nav and button chrome so interactive controls feel modern/tappable against the otherwise engraved brand voice.

heading-display.weight: regular (400 — the licensed face's display weight)
heading-display.effect: occasionally rendered with the gold gilded-gradient fill (see tier2SignatureSurfaces)

utility-label.case: sentence-in-pill (site does not force UPPER on nav labels)

typography.reversedTypeRule: The whole site is reversed (light text on near-black); no further weight/size bump was observed beyond the brand's own defaults — treat the dark backdrop as the default ground, not an exception.

observedCss.fontSizeMobile: unresolved at 1280px viewport [inferred smaller on mobile]

observedCss.selector: h3 (subheading/eyebrow, rendered — e.g. "What's New in Diablo Immortal")

observedCss.source: getComputedStyle on live DOM; background #7b2917 confirmed as the brick-500 token

heading.proxyRationale: Exocet Immortal is Blizzard's self-hosted, licensed display face (served from blz-contentstack-assets.akamaized.net, no public licence). Its signature unicase letterforms and rune-slashed 'O' glyph are unique and cannot be proxied visually — Cinzel is used only as this guide's nearest openly-licensed gothic-serif display stand-in. Production use requires sourcing the real Exocet Immortal woff2 files (or a properly licensed equivalent) and writing @font-face in the theme CSS.

body.proxyRationale: Already freely available — use directly, no proxy needed.

motifs: softly rounded (≈8px) pill buttons and nav chrome
carved-stone ornamental dividers between sections (not a token — a texture image)

lightingModel.interactiveElements: flat brick-500 fill + white label, textured with a baked highlight/gradient button-texture image rather than a CSS box-shadow — reads as forged metal/stone, not flat material UI
lightingModel.nonInteractiveElements: flat dark neutral panels with painterly key-art backdrops; no drop shadow on static content blocks
lightingModel.vfxSignature: ember/fire particles, arcane glow rim-lighting on character renders, smoke and blood-red highlights tied to each class's theme

states.hover: [inferred] baked highlight state via a second button-texture image swap rather than a simple overlay tint
states.pressed: [inferred] darker/desaturated texture swap, consistent with the hover pattern
states.focus: visible focus ring required (not directly observed — accessibility floor)
states.primaryActionRule: one primary action per view — the hero, each promo card, and the footer each carry exactly one dominant CTA ("Play Now")

accessibility.statusNotByColourAlone: no status-colour-only usage was observed on this marketing surface; carry the rule forward for cart/checkout surfaces — pair statusPositive/Negative with an icon or label
accessibility.focusRing: present on every focusable element (not directly verifiable via static capture — treat as a floor requirement)
accessibility.notes: No failing pairing was found among the sampled combinations; avoid untested gold-on-blue or gold-on-light-art pairings without a scrim.

halftone.rule: not observed — brand uses photographic/painted texture, not halftone dot patterns

distress.rule: baked into imagery only (carved-stone edges, worn leather, aged parchment) — never a CSS distress filter; do not add a CSS distress effect, source or commission textured art instead

texture.other: carved stone-relief and leather/desert surface texture across backgrounds, dividers, and button chrome — the dominant material language beyond flat colour

motion.interactiveFeedback: [inferred] brightness/texture-swap on hover for CTAs, consistent with the baked-texture button system

assetPrompts.heroBanner: Dark fantasy action-RPG hero banner, 16:9. A battle-scarred demon-hunting character mid-action against a hell-scorched ruined landscape, dramatic ember-orange rim light from distant fires, deep near-black shadow tones, painterly stylized-realism rendering, carved stone and molten rock texture in the environment, smoke and floating embers, cinematic low camera angle, colour palette anchored on ember gold (#D7AB6D) and blood-brick red-brown (#7B2917) against near-black (#1A1715), no text overlay.
assetPrompts.skuArt: Character bust portrait, 2:3 portrait crop, three-quarter angle, dramatic single-source fire/arcane rim light separating the figure from a dark carved-stone backdrop, ornate demon-forged armour or infernal magic effects appropriate to the class, painterly stylized-realism rendering matching AAA dark-fantasy ARPG key art, ember-gold and blood-brick accent lighting, no text.
assetPrompts.background: Seamless tileable dark stone-relief texture with faint carved rune details, near-black base (#1A1715) with subtle warm ember-gold (#D7AB6D) highlight catching the carved edges, very low contrast so UI content stays legible on top, no characters, no text.

codashop.architectureNote: 5-tier cascade: (1) type primitives + ref seeds → (2) palette ramps (--x-palette-{role}-500 = --x-ref-{role}) → (3) sys intensity / dimensions / effects / states → (4) semantic defaults (--x-bg-*, --x-text-*, --x-border-*) → (5) .text-style-* classes. Figma token exports drop the --x- prefix; repo names always include it. emitter.ts injects only Tier 1 ref seeds + optional Tier 2 ramps + font + --x-bg-page. Tiers 3-4 auto-resolve downstream and are store-overridable. THREE override layers: SYSTEM CONSTANT (layoutSystem + the 27 textStyle compositions + scales — never change) ⊃ BRAND-LOCKED (ref seeds, font, size values, brandCharacter) ⊃ STORE-FLEXIBLE (semantic colour mapping, component variants).

layoutSystem.containerRule: device screen sets container-type:inline-size; overlay must NOT (traps position:fixed)

spanVariants.content: full width on XS/S; centred cols 3–10 of 12, max-width 960px, on M/L
spanVariants.carousel: full-bleed on XS/S (negative margin cancels grid margin); content on M/L

layoutSystem.tokenTierDiscipline: components consume ONLY semantic (--x-bg-*, --x-text-*, --x-border-*) + spacing/size (--x-pad-*, --x-gap-*, --x-radius-*, --x-size-*); NEVER --x-sys-*, --x-palette-*, or --x-ref-* directly
layoutSystem.mobileDesktopRule: values switch at breakpoints via -desktop- token twins: --x-sys-space-desktop-*, --x-sys-radius-desktop-*, --x-sys-size-control-desktop-*, --x-text-size-desktop-*

palette.anchorRule: --x-palette-{role}-500 resolves to --x-ref-{role} — the 500 step IS the seed

semanticDefaults._note: Every mapping below is store-overridable. Tag them as suggestions, not requirements.

bg.--x-bg-action-primary: var(--x-sys-colour-secondary-main)   /* overridable — brand uses brick, not gold, for the physical CTA fill */

text.--x-text-secondary: var(--x-sys-colour-primary-main)     /* overridable — gilded gold for eyebrow/label text */

buttonPrimary.colourDepthNote: brick-500 (secondary seed) at 'main' step is the observed default, not the gold primary — gold is reserved for text/labels, brick for the physical button fill

input.feel: [inferred — no forms observed on this marketing surface] clean, clearly editable, staying dark and unobtrusive

modal.feel: [inferred] focused, elevated, dark scrim consistent with the rest of the site's near-black grounding

tier2SignatureSurfaces.name: Gilded gradient text-fill on subheadings/eyebrows
tier2SignatureSurfaces.surface: H3-tier subheading/eyebrow labels (e.g. "What's New in Diablo Immortal")
tier2SignatureSurfaces.implementation: background: linear-gradient(180deg, #9B7644 0%, #D7AB6D 100%); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent;
tier2SignatureSurfaces.precedentFile: observed via getComputedStyle on the live homepage — no local file, document as a component-level CSS pattern

tier2SignatureSurfaces.name: Carved-stone ornamental section dividers
tier2SignatureSurfaces.implementation: full-bleed /background-image using a bespoke carved-stone divider graphic (fancy-divider-top/bottom.jpeg, stone-divider-top/bottom.jpeg) rather than a CSS border or rule

tier2SignatureSurfaces.name: Baked-texture CTA button states
tier2SignatureSurfaces.implementation: background is a layered stack of colour-tint gradients over a baked highlight-texture image (DI_Button-Textures_Primary/Secondary-400) rather than a flat fill + CSS box-shadow; hover/pressed states are expected to swap to sibling texture assets, not a simple overlay tint

tier2SignatureSurfaces.name: Exocet Immortal unicase + rune-slashed 'O'
tier2SignatureSurfaces.implementation: the licensed display face itself renders unicase letterforms with a distinctive rune-like diagonal slash through the 'O' — no font substitution reproduces this; treat it as an irreplaceable brand asset, not a styleable property
tier2SignatureSurfaces.precedentFile: n/a — typeface-level signature, source the real Exocet Immortal font files for production
